messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The messages to be sent to the agent.

input.title: Input
input.description: Syntactic sugar for a single user message. Equivalent to messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': input}].

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps the agent should take to process the request.

use_assistant_message.title: Use Assistant Message
use_assistant_message.description: Whether the server should parse specific tool call arguments (default `send_message`) as `AssistantMessage` objects. Still supported for legacy agent types, but deprecated for letta_v1_agent onward.

assistant_message_tool_name.title: Assistant Message Tool Name
assistant_message_tool_name.description: The name of the designated message tool. Still supported for legacy agent types, but deprecated for letta_v1_agent onward.

assistant_message_tool_kwarg.title: Assistant Message Tool Kwarg
assistant_message_tool_kwarg.description: The name of the message argument in the designated message tool. Still supported for legacy agent types, but deprecated for letta_v1_agent onward.

include_return_message_types.title: Include Return Message Types
include_return_message_types.description: Only return specified message types in the response. If `None` (default) returns all messages.

enable_thinking.title: Enable Thinking
enable_thinking.description: If set to True, enables reasoning before responses or tool calls from the agent.

client_tools.title: Client Tools
client_tools.description: Client-side tools that the agent can call. When the agent calls a client-side tool, execution pauses and returns control to the client to execute the tool and provide the result via a ToolReturn.

client_skills.title: Client Skills
client_skills.description: Client-side skills available in the environment. These are rendered in the system prompt's available skills section alongside agent-scoped skills from MemFS.

override_model.title: Override Model
override_model.description: Model handle to use for this request instead of the agent's default model. This allows sending a message to a different model without changing the agent's configuration.

include_compaction_messages.title: Include Compaction Messages
include_compaction_messages.description: If True, compaction events emit structured `SummaryMessage` and `EventMessage` types. If False (default), compaction messages are not included in the response.

return_logprobs.title: Return Logprobs
return_logprobs.description: If True, returns log probabilities of the output tokens in the response. Useful for RL training. Only supported for OpenAI-compatible providers (including SGLang).

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position (0-20). Requires return_logprobs=True.

return_token_ids.title: Return Token Ids
return_token_ids.description: If True, returns token IDs and logprobs for ALL LLM generations in the agent step, not just the last one. Uses SGLang native /generate endpoint. Returns 'turns' field with TurnTokenData for each assistant/tool turn. Required for proper multi-turn RL training with loss masking.

override_system.title: Override System
override_system.description: Optional per-request system prompt override. When set, this is passed directly to the underlying LLM request and bypasses the persisted/compiled system message for that request.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: Optional callback URL to POST to when the job completes
